Name: Norien's Stone Path and Fence Retexture
Author: CNorien
Description:
You don't like the vanilla stone path texture and it annoys you that it doesn't match the stone fence? Yeah, me neither. I already made this mod [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/stone-floor-retexture.114383/]ages ago[/url], so now it's time for a 2019 update of this mod, now including a cooler colored version with a matching stone fence. The warm version also matches eemie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1033]Iron Stone Cemetery Fence[/url]﻿ (she even linked to my old mod - now the circle is complete).

[b][size=4]THIS MOD INCLUDES[/size]
[/b][list]
[*]Two stone path options and one stone fence option
[*]Enable path and/or fence replacement separately in [b]config [/b]file
[*][b]Warm [/b]and [b]Cold [/b]option; warm is vanilla fence color, cold is vanilla floor color
[*]Also changes [b]icons [/b]in the crafting menu accordingly
[/list]
[size=4][b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Put the mod folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[*]Start the game once so that a config file is created
[/list]
[size=4][b]CONFIG OPTIONS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]  [code]"PathEnabled": "True"[/code] or [code]"False"[/code]
[*]  [code]"FenceEnabled": "True"[/code] or [code]"False"[/code] (only works for color variant Cold)
[*]  [code]"Color": "Warm"[/code] or [code]"Cold"[/code]
[/list][b]
Mods used in screenshots[/b]
[list]
[*]eemie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1033]Iron Stone Cemetery Fence[/url]﻿ (unofficial [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-8#post-3275040]Content Patcher conversion[/url]﻿)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿ ([url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-105#post-3335730]Unofficial Starblue Valley Update by mouse with contributions from dreew[/url]﻿)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1523]Missy's shirts[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2348]Kisekae [/url]﻿(look through comments for working version)
[/list]
